why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Pulsar Money site Go to the Pulsar Money website and read how the USD and EUR accounts, swaps and virtual card are described.
2 Step 2 : Get the app The homepage says the app is available on iOS and Android and offers a Download the app button for it.
3 Step 3 : Open an account The site says an account opens in minutes. It describes USD and EUR balances in one account.
4 Step 4 : Fund it with stablecoins Add money with the stablecoin that matches the currency balance. Read the conditions and limits the site notes before you fund anything.

5 Step 5 : Read about the virtual card The homepage describes a virtual USD card for subscriptions such as Netflix or Spotify and lists the card as the next step, so its availability is not confirmed there.
6 Step 6 : Subscribe for updates If you prefer to wait, enter your email in the form at the bottom of the Pulsar Money website to stay updated.
